name: Minamiaso (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Minamiaso village emblem in green and yellow: a green stylised letter M of mountains within an arc, with a yellow disc.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiaso, a village in Kumamoto Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 13 February 2005.

features.role: Minamiaso village emblem — a green stylised letter M of mountains within an arc, with a yellow disc
